_readme: Owner-confirmed commercial terms (27 Oct 2026). Shown on price/order pages. Update when policy changes.
deposit: Cylinder deposit applies when you take a new empty or filled cylinder into your custody; amount confirmed for your size and city before you agree.
exchange: Empty-for-full exchange is available when you return a compatible empty cylinder in acceptable condition; we confirm eligibility when you order.
newEmpty: New empty cylinders (steel and composite, standard sizes we stock) can be supplied with or without first fill; price quoted before delivery.
delivery: Delivery through our nationwide distributor network across Pakistan. Target in covered city areas: about one hour when a local team is available; otherwise the distributor contacts you personally to confirm the window. We confirm your street and timing before you agree.
deliveryShort: Delivery charge and timing are confirmed for your street before you agree.
delivery247Note: Order requests are accepted around the clock via call, WhatsApp and the website form from every province; fulfilment follows distributor availability in your area.
partnersCertifiedRule: Every distributor and supplier in our network must supply only cylinders that carry valid certification markings. Customers should check the marking and seal on delivery and refuse a damaged cylinder.
responseTime: We aim to reply to calls and WhatsApp within a few minutes during active hours.
stockPolicy: Standard cylinder sizes and listed appliances/accessories are held in inventory for same-day dispatch where the local team can fulfil; exact stock confirmed when you order.
